newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco seeks energy cooperation with China.
newsitem.headline: Morocco seeks energy cooperation with China.

text.p: Morocco said on Wednesday it planned to boost energy cooperation with China and offered a joint-venture sulphuric acid plant to be built in Morocco, an official at the energy ministry said on Wednesday.
The official said the issue was raised at talks between visiting Chinese deputy foreign minister Tian Zeng Pei and Moroccan Energy Minister Abdellatif Guerraoui.
He said Morocco, main phosphate exporter, offered China a joint venture plant to produce sulphuric acid in the North African country.
Morocco and China signed on Wednesday a bilateral agreement on maintaining Rabat's consulate in Hong Kong after the end of British rule in the territory next July, the official said.
This is Tian Zeng Pei's second visit to Morocco. He had attended the Economic Conference for the Middle East and North Africa in Casablanca in 1994.
